Name: More Club Weapons
Author: Lucidvisionsinc
Description:
[center]Forge Your Path with Swiftness and Power!

Two Versions:Forge your own combat adventure by choosing between two different versions of the More Clubs Weapons Mod. In the Vanilla Style version, each weapon transforms into a different type, with the Classic Wooden Cane becoming a formidable sword, the Eagle and Maple Wood Canes evolving into swift and deadly daggers, while the Walking Stick and others retain their vanilla club form. Alternatively, the Original Faster Cooldown version keeps all the weapons as club-style, with enhanced cooldown for a more streamlined combat experience.


The Dragon Staff:As Robin's most revered masterpiece, the Dragon Staff is an enduring symbol of her remarkable artistry and connection to the realm's hidden magic.

Ancient Staff of the Valley:Robin's precise craftsmanship has restored this artifact to its former glory, and wielding it evokes the essence of the valley's ancient spirits. 

Robin's Craftsmanship:The heart of the More Clubs Weapons Mod lies in Robin's masterpieces. Inspired by ancient legends and driven by her love for carpentry, Robin's weapons embody the very spirit of Stardew Valley.

Forge your path with swiftness and power! Install the required Json Assets and Advanced Melee Framework mods, and visit Robin's Carpenter Shop to claim your swift arsenal of club-style weapons. With these new tools at your disposal, conquer the mines, vanquish foes, and protect your farm with unmatched finesse and strength![/center]
